column1: # Pokémon Legends: Arceus, SDK 11. Started from dm/games/profile_guess.py's survey of the owner's 1.1.1 dump (androidswithy), then booted and played on a Galaxy S25+;
# on the Galar Native engine since 2026-11-08 (its setup on the phone, menu, drivers, Mali / Xclipse routes)
# the app's name when it runs this game, where its official releases are, and its icon: the ball's top colour and the ground (build_apk.py)
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie)

# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a large alias region; the heap check sizes the heap region from the heap the game asks for
# the pool bounds what the allocator maps (its address space is cut from 32 GB to 4 GB in patch_nso.py)
# ---- NVN driver constant segments (Mario's values, the translator's built-in layout, unless the engine says otherwise) ----

# the RomFS has Game Freak packs (GFLXPACK .gfpak: Pokémon Legends: Arceus) and main links Oodle: entries of compression 3 are Oodle, decoded for the split by the game's own decoder in the Mac host (dm/host/hle_oodle.c)
# shaders the game builds in memory: saved on the first runs and translated at the next start (Galar Native's capture path)
# the game hands the shared font address straight to ScalableFontEngine::LoadFont (no Decode), as SDK 10 and older do: with the BFTTF header every "?" lookup missed and main+0x11f890 crashed on null
# ZL aims, ZR throws: shown beside L and R
# Taps on menu items move the game's cursor there and press A (touch_menu.c): the ui2d pane classes found in main 1.1.1's memory (by their name-keyed objects
# and fields: name at +0xb0, parent at +0x18), valid for this build only
# The list selection class (count +0x8, selected index +0x14, columns +0x20, rows shown +0x24; found by the index following the D-pad): a tap writes the
# tapped item's index next to it and one D-pad press moves there, in place of walking the cursor (the Satchel's items, its party)
# The pop-up choice class (selected choice +0x8, choices +0x10: the Satchel's Use / Favorite / Discard / Cancel): a tap on a choice selects it the same way
# On phones: handheld mode (the game's lower render resolution); about 20 fps docked in Jubilife on the Galaxy S25+
# heavier than the Sword / Shield the Auto tiers were set on (about 20 fps docked on a Galaxy S25+): Auto picks one tier lower (GameSettings.profile)
